testCases.name: POST /api/register creates user with valid email and strong password
testCases.description: This test case verifies that a POST request to the /api/register endpoint creates a user with a valid email and a strong password.

steps.expectedResult: 201 Created, user created with valid email and strong password

testCases.expectedResult: The response status code should be 201, a new user should be created with the provided email and password, and the password should meet the application's strength requirements.

testCases.name: POST /api/register rejects invalid email
testCases.description: This test case verifies that a POST request to the /api/register endpoint rejects a user creation with an invalid email.

steps.expectedResult: 400 Bad Request, invalid email address error

testCases.expectedResult: The response status code should be 400, and the error message should indicate an invalid email address.

testCases.name: POST /api/register rejects weak password
testCases.description: This test case verifies that a POST request to the /api/register endpoint rejects a user creation with a weak password.
testCases.expectedResult: The response status code should be 400, and the error message should indicate a weak password.

testCases.name: POST /api/register returns 409 for duplicate email
testCases.description: This test case verifies that a POST request to the /api/register endpoint returns a 409 status code when attempting to create a user with an email that already exists.
testCases.expectedResult: The response status code should be 409, and the error message should indicate a duplicate email address.

testCases.name: POST /api/login allows valid credentials
testCases.description: This test case verifies that a POST request to the /api/login endpoint allows a user to log in with valid credentials.
testCases.expectedResult: The response status code should be 200, and the user should be logged in successfully.

testCases.name: POST /api/login rejects invalid credentials with 401
testCases.description: This test case verifies that a POST request to the /api/login endpoint rejects a login attempt with invalid credentials.
testCases.expectedResult: The response status code should be 401, and the error message should indicate invalid credentials.

testCases.name: GET /health returns 200 with status ok
testCases.description: This test case verifies that the GET request to the /health endpoint returns a 200 status code with a status of 'ok'.
testCases.expectedResult: The response status code should be 200 and the status message should be 'ok'.
